description.narrative: The Voice program is an innovative grant facility with Oxfam in Nigeria as one of the implementing organisations. The granting process is informed by a context update process showing Oxfam in Nigeria what thematic area to prioritise. Oxfam in Nigeria launched the«Reclaim our Future» call for proposal which was focused on the social inclusion of women rightsholders. Under this call for proposal, two different Oxfam in Nigeria partners located in different parts of the country implemented projects with the objective of having women included in the local leadership council. This is something that has never existed in the history of both communities as local leadership are reserved for men. The local women groups supported by the project initiative were able to change a life-long tradition and had women leaders as part of the local governing council for the first time in the history of the community. This initiative was conducted in two culturally diverse locations of Enugu and Plateau states with a commonality of patriarchal dominance over women. This evaluation seeks to deep dive to understand the major factors and social drivers that resulted in this outcome, support rightsholders to understand simple approaches for evaluation which they can apply to assess quality of their advocacy, as well as understand challenges that may impede potentials for replication of such successes.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project’s implementation.
